messages:
maria_lopez: Quick weekly pulse for Acme — token usage & throughput highlights. QoQ tokens +14%, WoW -9%. Throughput (avg RPS) QoQ +18%, WoW -3%. P95 latency spiked Thu to ~420ms (baseline ~240–260ms). Error rate bumped to 1.6% Thu, baseline 0.2%. Spend MoM +7% so finance is asking.

jake_wong: Thanks — I saw the latency/error blip. Linked to a fallback to `model-v2-quant` at 09:32 Thu; autoscaler did cold starts and one node had an OOM then fallback. I can dig logs.

maria_lopez: Can you pull last 7 days tokens/day + avg RPS so we can compare to last quarter? want to call out any backlog or batch-job causes.

jake_wong: Quick query I ran: ```SELECT date, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, AVG(rps) FROM usage WHERE account_id='acme' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 7;``` Raw: [Mar12: 1.10M, Mar11: 1.30M, Mar10: 1.00M, Mar09: 1.05M, Mar08: 1.20M, Mar07: 1.30M, Mar06: 1.15M]. Avg RPS last 7d ~ 42. Peak RPS +7% vs previous week.

sophia_ng: FYI — finance pinged about the spend uptick. They want quick reasoning: is this token inflation or model switching?

maria_lopez: @jake_wong can you confirm batching/quantization changes? If QoQ spend slope >10% we'll escalate to AM for renewal conversation.

jake_wong: Batching config unchanged. Root cause looks like two workflows that started sending longer prompts after a template change — avg sequence length +30% which increases tokens/request. Also we had more sustained peak RPS windows, which raised throughput-based spend.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed for `model-v2-quant` at 2026-03-19T09:34Z due to OOMs on node g4-16.

maria_lopez: Action items: 1) Jake — reduce canary concurrency and add autoscale warm-up (ETA 24h). 2) Ops/sales enablement — suggest throttling heavy workflows during business hours; @sophia_ng pls coordinate. 3) I'll draft a one-pager for AM explaining QoQ +14% tokens vs WoW -9% and the mitigation plan (due Mon).

acme-admin: Thanks — we rolled a template change late-night; will revert the long prompts to previous shorter version and run tests. Will update by EOD.

jake_wong: Noted. I'll add a temporary routing rule to steer heavy jobs to the off-peak pool and lower concurrency for the canary. Patch goes out in ~15m.

maria_lopez: :thumbsup: Follow-up in tomorrow's sync with updated metrics. TL;DR: QoQ growth healthy, short-term WoW dip plus latency/error blip from model fallback + longer sequences. No immediate renewal risk but monitoring closely.
